description: Defines classes and templates for Web transfer operations, including client and server transfer types, with support for hashing, authorization, and transfer state management within a WebSocket/WebTransfer context.

classes.name: SingleElementFactoryType
classes.description: Factory for creating and managing a single element of a specified type, with reference counting.

classes.name: ClientTransferType
classes.description: Handles client-side web transfer operations including collect, upload, and download, with transfer state management.

classes.name: ServerTransferType
classes.description: Handles server-side web transfer operations, processing incoming requests and serving files with authorization and hash validation.

methods.name: StartTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer with a given request.

methods.name: CollectInfo
methods.description: Collects information about a source URL.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Uploads a file to a destination URL.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a source URL to a destination file.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Virtual method to setup remote connection parameters.

methods.name: InfoCollected
methods.description: Virtual callback when info is collected.

methods.name: Transferred
methods.description: Virtual callback when transfer is completed.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Virtual method to authorize incoming requests.
